description: This file defines an SCSS mixin library called RFS (Responsive Font Sizes), which automates the generation of responsive size values for CSS properties like font-size, padding, and margins based on viewport dimensions. It includes configuration variables, functions for unit conversions and calculations, and mixins for applying responsive styles with optional media query controls.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Performs division of two numbers with specified precision, handling units and sign, and used internally for calculations.

methods.name: rfs-value
methods.description: Converts a list of size values into a CSS string, adjusting units as needed.

methods.name: rfs-fluid-value
methods.description: Calculates responsive, fluid size values based on viewport and configuration, producing CSS calc() expressions for smooth scaling.

methods.name: rfs
methods.description: Main mixin to apply responsive font sizes or other properties, utilizing rfs-value and rfs-fluid-value for dynamic sizing, with media query controls.

methods.name: font-size
methods.description: Shorthand mixin for applying responsive font-size.
